# conveyor_service_account (Resource)

A service account: a stable machine identity that credential tokens nest under. Permissions are bound to the service account itself, so rotating its tokens never touches its grants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "conveyor_service_account" "my_service_account" {
  name            = "my_service_account"
  type            = "scoped"
  project_ids     = [conveyor_project.my_project.id]
  environment_ids = [conveyor_environment.my_environment.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service account. Must be unique within the tenant. Renaming is not supported: changing this value destroys and recreates the service account, along with any tokens created under it.
- `type` (String) The type of the service account. Valid values: `scoped`, `admin`. An `admin` service account bypasses project/environment scoping entirely, so changing between `scoped` and `admin` destroys and recreates the resource rather than silently escalating privileges in place.

### Optional

- `environment_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the environments this service account is scoped to. Must be empty when `type = "admin"`. Can be changed in place; existing tokens are unaffected.
- `project_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the projects this service account is scoped to. Must be empty when `type = "admin"`. Can be changed in place; existing tokens are unaffected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the service account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
export SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(conveyor service-account get --name my_service_account -ojson | jq -r ".id")
terraform import conveyor_service_account.my_service_account "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID"
```
